id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying saml connections 422s from unsupported accounts

review.posthog_relevance: Adds Clerk-specific error handling for SAML connection failures, distinguishing account-level limitations from transient errors to prevent unnecessary retries and provide actionable user guidance.
review.reason: Adds a non-retryable error entry for Clerk 422 responses and its corresponding test. This distinguishes account-level limitations (SAML unavailability) from transient errors, allowing PostHog to stop retrying and provide a clear action to the user. The implementation and relevant checks are visible.
review.uncertainty: The score relies on the assumption that this error handling is not already covered or that this specific distinction represents a substantive improvement rather than a minor maintenance update. No broader systemic changes or wider adoption metrics are available.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the new 422 error handling, only the addition of the error message and its corresponding test. The score cannot be assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new non-retryable error entry for Clerk 422 responses, scoped to the SAML connections endpoint, and adds tests to verify this error is recognized and distinguished from other 422 responses.
observations.code_quote: "422 Client Error: Unprocessable Entity for url: https://api.clerk.com/v1/saml_connections": "SAML connections (Enterprise SSO) aren't available on your Clerk plan or instance. Turn off syncing for this table, or enable SAML connections in your Clerk dashboard.",
observations.posthog_connection: This change improves the reliability of the Clerk warehouse connector by correctly identifying account-level limitations (SAML unavailability) versus transient or request-specific errors, allowing PostHog to stop retrying and provide a clear action to the user.
